name: Philips Avent Mumpot My Easy Sip Cup 200ml 6month+ Random Colour (Made in Indonesia)
description:
Brand: Philips Avent
Product Name: My Easy Sip Cup / Mumpot
Capacity: 200ml
Age Group: 6 months+
Origin: Made in Indonesia
Material: Polypropylene & Silicone Rubber
Color: Multiple colors, randomly selected

Features & Benefits

Soft Silicone Spout: Easy for babies to drink comfortably.

Easy to Hold: Rippled container shape ensures a steady grip for little hands.

Thoughtful Design: One-piece silicone spout for easy assembly and cleaning.

Dishwasher Safe: Convenient for parents.

Compatible: Works well with Philips Avent bottles and cups.

Durable & Safe: Crafted with baby-safe materials for everyday use.
